S0_PRODUCTION_AUTHORITY_SURFACE.paths: all E2 runtime source, acquisition/extraction logic, rule/configuration files, prompts/templates that can influence prediction, qualification logic, and fresh-selection weights

requirements: must reference development-universe member id or be declared pure synthetic
must never be imported as hidden production lookup data
must be excluded from fresh held-out inputs

S2_IMMUTABLE_HISTORY.rule: May contain target-specific names by historical necessity; immutable history is not evidence of E2 specialization and must not be rewritten to pass the audit.

baseline_tree_observation.interpretation: There is no E2 implementation to exonerate yet; this is the baseline against which all later E2-introduced executable/configuration/prompt bytes are audited.

development_case_spellings_policy.allowed_only_if: represented as a versioned carrier/profile lexicon independent of repository identity, justified as a general cross-target rule, and qualified on synthetic or multiple independent non-origin examples
development_case_spellings_policy.forbidden: using one known development spelling as a direct shortcut to a definitive verdict

carrier_vocabulary_policy.normalization_preferred: token decomposition plus casing/separator normalization should discover spellings rather than a list written to fit known targets

claim_boundary: Passing this audit can support absence of detected target-specific specialization under the declared static and metamorphic checks; it cannot prove absence of all overfitting or establish fresh generalization.
final_freeze_evidence_required: exact list and hashes of E2 S0 files
carrier lexicon/profile diff and justification if any
literal_fingerprint_classes: repository owner/name strings from effective development universe
organization names when used to branch behavior
screened operation names when used as special-case selectors
gold verdict/witness labels keyed to a development target
purpose: Define a pre-implementation zero-point and a two-layer audit that detects both literal target specialization and behavioral specialization hidden behind generic-looking code.

required_behavioral_audit_at_e2_freeze.failure: Any semantic outcome change attributable only to target identity or nonmaterial renaming blocks E2 freeze.
metamorphic_tests: repository-owner/name anonymization with program bytes and semantics fixed must not change semantic prediction/certificate
path renaming preserving imports/resolution must not change semantic prediction except evidence locations
function/class/local identifier alpha-renaming must not change semantic prediction
nonmaterial metadata/comment/logging changes must not change semantic prediction
equivalent casing/serialization spelling mediated by explicit mapping must preserve semantic interpretation
permutation of irrelevant file enumeration order must not change selected semantic evidence after canonical tie-breaking

flag_resolution: move true development material to S1
or document a general carrier rule plus cross-target qualification
required_static_audit_at_e2_freeze.hash_obfuscation_rule: encoded, hashed, abbreviated, or transformed target identifiers count as the same forbidden specialization

test_authority_firewall.development_real_target_tests: may assert reproduction/diagnostic objectives but cannot be the sole qualification evidence for a general rule
test_authority_firewall.fresh_targets: must not enter any E2 test fixture before fresh first-prediction block seal
test_authority_firewall.pure_synthetic_and_mutation_truth: must be predeclared independently of E2 output
